rule: The closed words of an instrument (spending authority G2.1) and the instrument rows that fix a namespace (G10.3 X10). classes, funders and custodies are G2.1's. caps says what bounds a source outside the app: provider (a limit the provider enforces on the credential) or core_only (none; the provider balance is the exposure). time_sources says what time an instrument's provider gives (G5.2 rule 1). marks are flags a row may carry; test_network means the row can never hold real value (G10.1). A row's namespace is fixed by the row and no request chooses it: provider sandbox is sandbox, and a provider with no row here is live. host and time_key of the sandbox row are null until the sandbox provider host exists (X8). A case asks for a provider id's namespace.
